summary: BranchOut Food Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Warrant Exercise and Amendment to Note and Warrant Agreement with Kaufman Kapital LLC. Kaufman exercised a warrant for 500,000 shares at $1.50/share for $750,000 cash to the company. The parties also extended the maturity of a 12% senior secured convertible note (original principal up to $3.4M, current balance $2.9M) from Dec 31, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027, reduced the interest rate to 8%, and restricted prepayment of over $2.4M before Sep 30, 2027. The company agreed to file resale registration statements for Kaufman. This is a routine debt amendment and warrant exercise, not a special situation.
